title: Badge
description: A read-only status or tag in a tone (10% fill, no border, theme-safe text; one fixed palette for every brand), tone="overlay" for text on an image or video, and the attention marks in the brand colour: CountBadge (unread, to approve; 99+ cap) and NewTag ("Mới").
when: Status of a row or card (Đã thanh toán, Lỗi), a plan or role tag.
Text on an image or video (a duration, "Video", a page count on a thumbnail): tone="overlay", and only there.
Something waits for the user (unread, to approve): CountBadge, or Button badge on an icon button.
A new feature or item in a menu: NewTag.

instead.need: A count next to a title that is not an alert

a11y: Text, not colour alone, carries the meaning; it never wraps.
A count on an icon button is said in the button's aria-label.

examples.title: On media (tone="overlay")
examples.description: Only on an image or video: the canvas grey at 55% with a 12px backdrop blur behind the strong text. On a page or a card use a tone.

examples.title: Attention marks
examples.description: CountBadge in the brand fill (99+ cap; tone="neutral" for a plain count), Button badge at a button's corner (the count goes in an icon button's aria-label; a button with text and no aria-label gets it as screen-reader text), NewTag: the brand at 18% behind brand text, or the strong text where the brand is not AA on it.
